reviewer: principal engineer and game-economy auditor (deep audit)
regressions: The Auto-Trainer only replays cleared legs but is switched on by default when earned. With it on, Start at -> Frontier snapped back to a replay, and its callout and task row still described the old full-charge trainer (patched d984ad3)
tools/sim.js's default mode (HYBRID unset) can't get past skill 3 since the Auto-Trainer change, so the documented sim command reported no General AI (patched 5ea120c)
unresolvedRisks: A player who never turns the Auto-Trainer off still stays on their current skill (sim: no new skill from minute 14 to minute 150). Only the callout and Start at help now

Passive leg XP is 85-91% of all XP over the first version (27-35% up to General AI). The tree is bought out by about 70-80 min and XP piles up in Scale Up. Changing clearedRate by 20% either way barely moves the pace

16 of 56 tree nodes (16% of the tree's XP) only boost act-one stats. The far-ring ones (Quantum Network, Wafer-Scale Engine, Round-the-Clock Ops, Global Benchmark, Chain of Thought: about 646K XP) only become affordable once the frontier is in act two, where they do nothing

Late pace depends exponentially on pushCostLate (x1.2 -> skill 14 +63%). General AI time moves by +-11% from seed chaos alone at +-5% coefficient changes, so tuning claims based on 3 seeds are within noise
The run loop exists twice (game.js and tools/sim.js). The sync test compares names, not behaviour
Google Fonts is the only network dependency (a desktop/Steam build must bundle the fonts)
